about: Structure for the sample backlog in tasks.md, as an agent would build it: the owner's requirements (rephrased), phases and sub-groups with goals, which tasks serve which requirement, labels on phase links (what flows) and notes. Tasks themselves come from tasks.md.

requirements.title: Collect every earnings call automatically
requirements.detail: Detect each announced call for covered companies, fetch the recording and slide deck (including company-hosted webcasts) and transcribe it daily without hand work.

requirements.title: Pull out forward-looking claims
requirements.detail: From each transcript extract mentions, terms, facts and forward-looking statements, graded against a quality bar before they are stored.

requirements.title: Connect claims to a knowledge graph
requirements.detail: Link each claim to companies, products, segments and terms, keeping sources and lineage.

requirements.title: Check promises against reported results
requirements.detail: Compare each forward-looking statement with later reported results (including segment figures) and score each company's track record.

requirements.title: Publish it on the site
requirements.detail: Public scorecard, company pages and topic pages; only republishable quotes; public only after the owner approves.

requirements.title: Run daily, unattended, within budget
requirements.detail: One evening run plus an overnight backlog lane; every model call configurable; spend capped with alerts.

groups.name: Collect & transcribe
groups.goal: Every announced call is fetched and transcribed, unattended

groups.name: Extract claims
groups.goal: Each call yields graded facts and forward-looking statements

groups.name: Claims extractor
groups.goal: A glossary-aware extractor that passes its quality bar

groups.name: Coverage & backlog
groups.goal: The right calls get extracted, newest first, within budget

groups.name: Knowledge graph
groups.goal: Claims link to companies, products, terms and sources

groups.name: Store & readers
groups.goal: One graph store with lineage and one shared reader

groups.name: Terms & glossary
groups.goal: Ambiguous terms resolve without hand work

groups.name: Company facts
groups.goal: Segments, customers and report figures are in the graph

groups.name: Check promises
groups.goal: Statements are checked against results; companies get a track record

groups.name: Publish
groups.goal: Scorecard, company and topic pages are live

groups.name: Run & operate
groups.goal: One daily run, switchable models, spend under control

groups.name: Reference case
groups.goal: One reference company passes every bar and is frozen as the benchmark
